original: nādityaḥ saṃvatsara eva pratyakṣeṇa priyatamaṃ vidyāt | etadvai saṃvatsarasya priyatamaṃ rūpam | yo'sya mahānartha utpatsyamāno bhavati | idaṃ puṇyaṃ kuruṣveti | tamāharaṇaṃ dadyāt | yathā lakṣaṇa ṛtulakṣaṇaṃ bhuvanaṃ sapta ca

original: sākaṃjānāṃ saptathamāhurekajam | ṣaḍudyamā ṛṣayo devajā iti | teṣāmiṣṭāni vihitāni dhāmaśaḥ | sthātre rejante vikṛtāni rūpaśaḥ | ko nu maryā amithitaḥ | sakhā sakhāyamabravīt | jahāko asmadīṣate | yastityāja sakhividaṃ sakhāyam | na tasya vācyapi bhogo asti | yadīṃ śṛṇotyalakaṃ śṛṇoti | na hi praveda sukṛtasya panthāmiti | ṛturṛtunā nudyamānaḥ |

original: vinanādābhidhāvaḥ | ṣaṣṭiśca triṃśakā valgāḥ | śuklakṛṣṇau ca ṣaṣṭikau | sārāgavastrairjaradakṣaḥ | vasanto vasubhiḥ saha | saṃvatsarasya savituḥ | praiṣakṛtprathamaḥ smṛtaḥ | amūnādayatetyanyān amūṃśca parirakṣataḥ | etā vācaḥ prayujyante | yatraitadupadṛśyate | etadeva vijānīyāt | pramāṇaṃ kālaparyaye | viśeṣaṇaṃ tu vakṣyāmaḥ |

analyzed: rejatī rodasī ubhe iti vātāt viṣṇoḥ balam āhuḥ akṣarāt dīptiḥ ucyate tripadāt dhārayat devaḥ yat viṣṇoḥ ekam uttamam iti agnayaḥ vāyavaḥ ca eva etat asya parāyaṇam iti pṛcchāmi tvām param mṛtyum avamam madhyamam catum lokam ca puṇya pāpānām etat pṛcchāmi saṃprati iti amum āhuḥ param mṛtyum pavamānam tu madhyamam agniḥ eva avamaḥ mṛtyuḥ

original: rodasyorantardeśeṣu | tatra nyasyante vāsavaiḥ, iti | te'śarīrāḥ prapadyante | yathā'puṇyasya karmaṇaḥ | apāṇyapādakeśāsaḥ | tatra te'yonijā janāḥ, iti | mṛtvā punarmṛtyumāpadyante | adyamānāḥ svakarmabhiḥ | āśātikāḥ krimaya iva | tataḥ pūyante vāsavaiḥ, iti | apaitaṃ mṛtyuṃ jayati | ya evaṃ veda | sa khalvaivaṃvidbrāhmaṇaḥ |

analyzed: tāmraḥ aruṇaḥ tau a visṛṣṭau daṃpatī eva bhavataḥ iti tayoḥ etau vatsau vṛtraḥ ca vaidyutaḥ ca agneḥ vṛtraḥ vaidyutaḥ ādityasya tau a visṛṣṭau daṃpatī eva bhavataḥ iti tayoḥ etau vatsau uṣmā ca nīhāraḥ ca vṛtrasya ūṣmā vaidyutasya nīhāraḥ tau tau eva pratipadyete iti sā iyam rātrī garbhiṇī putreṇa saṃvasati tasyāḥ vai etat ulbaṇam

analyzed: yat rātrau raśmayaḥ yathā goḥ garbhiṇyāḥ ulbaṇam evam etasyām ulbaṇam iti prajayiṣṇuḥ prajayā ca paśubhiḥ ca bhavati yaḥ evam veda etam udyantam apiyantam ca iti ādityaḥ puṇyasya vatsaḥ iti atha pavitrā aṅgirasaḥ iti stha upodakābhiḥ vaśī dadhāthe agniḥ tayoḥ etau vatsau bhavati catvāri ca

analyzed: pavitravantaḥ pari vājam āsate pitā eṣām pratnaḥ abhirakṣati vratam mahaḥ samudram varuṇaḥ tirodadhe dhīrāḥ id śekuḥ dharuṇeṣu ārabham iti pavitram te vitatam brahmaṇaspate prabhuḥ gātrāṇi paryeṣi viśvatas a tapta tanūḥ na tat āmaḥ aśnute śṛtāsaḥ id vahantaḥ tat samāśata iti brahmā devānām iti asataḥ sadye tatakṣuḥ ṛṣayaḥ saptātriḥ ca yat tat asataḥ sadye tatakṣuḥ ṛṣayaḥ saptātriḥ ca yat tat asataḥ sadye tatakṣu

original: sarve'trayo agastyaśca | nakṣatraiḥ śaṃkṛto'vasan, iti | atha savituḥ śyāvāśvasyāvartikāmasya, iti | amī ya ṛkṣā nihitāsa uccā | naktaṃ dadṛśre kuhaciddiveyuḥ | adabdhāni varuṇasya vratāni | vicākaśaccandramā nakṣatrameti, iti | tatsaviturvareṇyam | bhargo devasya dhīmahi | dhiyo yo naḥ pracodayāt, iti | tatsaviturvṛṇīmahe |

original: vayaṃ devasya bhojanam | śreṣṭhaṃ sarvadhātamam | turaṃ bhagasya dhīmahi, iti | apāgūhata savitā tṛbhīn | sarvāndivo andhasaḥ | naktaṃ tānyabhavandṛśe | asthyasthnā saṃbhaviṣyāmaḥ, iti | nāma nāmaiva nāma me | napuṃsakaṃ pumāṃstryasmi | sthāvaro'smyatha jaṅgamaḥ | yaje'yakṣi yaṣṭāhe ca, iti | mayā bhūtānyayakṣata | paśavo mama bhūtāni |
analyzed: vayam devasya bhojanam śreṣṭham sarva dhātamam turam bhagasya dhīmahi iti apāgūhata savitā tṛbhīn sarvān divaḥ andhasaḥ naktam tāni abhavan dṛśe asthi asthnā saṃbhaviṣyāmaḥ iti nāma nāma eva nāma me napuṃsakam pumān tri asmi sthāvaraḥ asmi atha jaṅgamaḥ yajeyakṣi yaṣṭā ahe ca iti mayā bhūtāni ayakṣata paśavaḥ mama bhūtāni

original: anūbandhyo'smyahaṃ vibhuḥ, iti | striyaḥ satīḥ | tā u me puṃsa āhuḥ | paśyadakṣaṇvānna vicetadandhaḥ | kaviryaḥ putraḥ sa imā ciketa | yastā vi'jānātsavituḥ pitā sat, iti | andho maṇimavindat | tamanaṅgulirāvayat | agrīvaḥ pratyamuñcat | tamajihvā asaścata, iti | ūrdhvamūlamavākchākham | vṛkṣaṃ yo veda saṃprati | na sa jātu janaḥ śraddadhyāt |
analyzed: anūbandhyā asmi aham vibhuḥ iti striyaḥ satīḥ tāḥ u me puṃsaḥ āhuḥ paśyat akṣaṇvān na vicetat andhaḥ kaviḥ yaḥ putraḥ saḥ imā ciketa yaḥ tā vijānāt savituḥ pitā sat iti andhaḥ maṇim avindat tam anaṅguliḥ āvayat agrīvaḥ pratyamuñcat tam ajihvāḥ asaścataḥ iti ūrdhva mūlam avāk śākham vṛkṣam yaḥ veda saṃprati na sa jātu janaḥ śraddadhyāt

original: matyurmā mārayāditiḥ, iti | hasitaṃ ruditaṃ gītam | vīṇā paṇavalāsitam | mṛtaṃ jīvaṃ ca yatkiṃcit | aṅgāni sneva viddhi tat, iti | atṛṣyaṃstṛṣya dhyāyat | asmājjātā me mithū caran | putro nirṛtyā vaidehaḥ | acetā yaśca cetanaḥ, iti | sa taṃ maṇimavindat | so'naṅgulirāvayat | so'grīvaḥ pratyamuñcat | so'jihvo asaścata, iti |

original: naitamṛṣiṃ viditvā nagaraṃ praviśet | yadi praviśet | mithau caritvā praviśet | tatsaṃbhavasya vratam, iti | ā tamagne rathaṃ tiṣṭha | ekāśvamekayojanam | ekacakramekadhuram | vātadhrājigatiṃ vibho, iti | na riṣyati na vyathate | nāsyākṣo yātu sajjati | yacchvetānrohitāṃścāgneḥ | rathe yuktvā'dhitiṣṭhati, iti | ekayā ca daśabhiśca svabhūte |
analyzed: na etam ṛṣim viditvā nagaram praviśet yadi praviśet mithau caritvā praviśet tat saṃbhavasya vratam iti ā tam agne ratham tiṣṭhe eka aśvam eka yojanam eka cakram eka dhuram vāta dhrāji gatim vibho iti na riṣyati na vyathate na asya akṣaḥ yātu sajjati yat śvetān rohitān ca agneḥ rathe yuktvā adhitiṣṭhati iti ekayā ca daśabhiḥ ca svabhūte

original: dvābhyāmiṣṭaye viṃśatyā ca | tisṛbhiśca vahase triṃśatā ca | niyudbhirvāyaviha tā vimuñca iti || tatakṣurdhīmahi nāma me ciketa gītaṃ pratyamuñcadvyathate sapta ca ||

original: nityāste'nucarāstava, iti | subrahmaṇyoṃ subrahmaṇyoṃ | indrā''gaccha hariva āgaccha medhātitheḥ | meṣa vṛṣaṇaśvasya mene | gaurāvaskandinnahalyāyai jāra | kauśikabrāhmaṇa gautamabruvāṇa, iti | aruṇāśvā ihā''gatāḥ | vasavaḥ pṛthivikṣitaḥ | aṣṭau digvāsaso'gnayaḥ | agniśca jātavedāścetyete, iti | tāmrāśvāstāmrarathāḥ | tāmravarṇāstathā'sitāḥ |

original: daṇḍahastāḥ khādagdataḥ | ito rudrāḥ parāṃ gatāḥ | uktaṃ sthānaṃ pramāṇaṃ ca pura ita, iti | bṛhaspatiśca savitā ca | viśvarūpairihā''gatām | rathenodakavartmanā | apsuṣā iti taddvayoḥ, iti | ukto veṣo vāsāṃsi ca | kālāvayavānāmitaḥ pratījyā | vāsātyā ityaśvinoḥ | ko'ntarikṣe śabdaṃ karotīti | vāsiṣṭho rauhiṇo mīmāṃsāṃ cakre |

original: tasyaiṣā bhavati, iti | vāśreva vidyuditi, iti | brahmaṇa udaraṇamasi | brahmaṇa udīraṇamasi | brahmaṇa āstaraṇamasi | brahmaṇa upastaraṇamasi, iti || dṛśyate ca mene parāṃ gatāścakre ṣaṭ ca ||

original: yo'sau tapannudeti | sa sarveṣāṃ bhūtānāṃ prāṇānādāyodeti | mā me prajāyā mā paśūnām | mā mama prāṇānādāyodagāḥ, iti | asau yo'stameti | sa sarveṣāṃ bhūtānāṃ prāṇānādāyāstametiṃ | mā me prajāyā mā paśūnām | mā mama prāṇānādāyāstaṃ gāḥ, iti | asau ya āpūryati | sa sarveṣāṃ bhūtānāṃ prāṇairāpūryati | mā me prajāyā mā paśūnām |

original: apāṃ rasamudayaṃ san | sūrye śukram samābhṛtam | apām̐ rasasya yo rasaḥ | taṃ vo gṛhṇāmyuttamamiti, iti | ime vai lokā apām̐ rasaḥ | te'muṣminnāditye samābhṛtāḥ, iti | jānudaghnīmuttaravedīṃ khātvā | apāṃ pūrayitvā gulphadaghnam | | puṣkaraparṇaiḥ puṣkaradaṇḍaiḥ puṣkaraiśca sam̐stīrya | tasminvihāyase | agniṃ praṇīyopasamādhāya,, iti |
analyzed: apām rasam udayam san sūrye śukram samābhṛtam apām rasasya yaḥ rasaḥ tam vaḥ gṛhṇāmi uttamam iti iti ime vai lokāḥ apām rasaḥ te amuṣmin āditye samābhṛtāḥ iti jānu daghnīm uttaravedīm khātvā apām pūrayitvā gulpha daghnam puṣkara parṇaiḥ puṣkara daṇḍaiḥ puṣkaraiḥ ca sam̐stīrya tasmin vihāyase agnim praṇīya upasamādhāya iti

original: brahmavādino vadanti | kasmātpraṇīte'yamagniścīyate | sāppraṇīte'yamapsu hyayaṃ cīyate | asau bhuvane'pyanāhitāgniretāḥ | tamabhita etā abīṣṭakā upadadhāti, iti | agnihotre darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ | paśubandhe cāturmāsyeṣu | atho āhuḥ | sarveṣu yajñakratuṣviti, iti | etaddha sma vā āhuḥ śaṇḍilāḥ | kamagniṃ cinute | satriyamagniṃ cinvānaḥ |

original: saṃvatsaraṃ pratyakṣeṇa, iti | kamagniṃ cinute | nāciketamagniṃ cinvānaḥ | prāṇānpratyakṣeṇa, iti | kamagniṃ cinute | cāturhotriyamagniṃ cinvānaḥ | brahma pratyakṣeṇa, iti | kamagniṃ cinute | vaiśvasṛjamagniṃ cinvānaḥ | śarīraṃ pratyakṣeṇa, iti | kamagniṃ cinute | upānuvākyamāśumagniṃ cinvānaḥ | imām̐llokānpratyakṣeṇa iti | kamagniṃ cinute |

original: imamāruṇaketukamagniṃ cinvāna iti | ya evāsau | itaścāmutaścāvyatīpātī | tamiti, iti | yo'gnermithūyā veda | mithunavānbhavati | āpo vā agnermithūyāḥ | mithunavānbhavati | ya evaṃ veda , iti |

original: puṣpamagnirvāyurasau vai tapan,candramā nakṣatrāṇi parjanyaḥ saṃvatsarastiṣṭhati satriyam̐ saṃvatsaram̐ sāvitramamuṃ nāciketaṃ prāṇām̐ścāturhotriyaṃ brahma vaiśvasṛjam̐ śarīramupānuvākyamāśumimām̐llokānimamāruṇaketukaṃ ya evāsau || iti kṛṣṇayajurvedīyataittirīyāraṇyake prathamaprapāṭhake dvāviṃśo'nuvākaḥ || 1.22 ||

original: āpo vā idamāsantsalilameva | sa prajāpatirekaḥ puṣkaraparṇe samabhavat | tasyāntarmanasi kāmaḥ samavartata | idam̐ sṛjeyamiti | tasmādyatpuruṣo manasā'bhigacchati | tadvācā vadati | tatkarmaṇā karoti | tadeṣā'bhyanūktā, iti |

original: antarataḥ kūrmaṃ bhūtam̐ sarpantam | tamabravīt | mama vai tvaṅmām̐sā | samabhūt | netyabravīt | pūrvamevāhamihā''samiti | tatpuruṣasya puruṣatvam | sa sahasraśīrṣā puruṣaḥ | sahasrākṣaḥ sahasrapāt | bhūtvodatiṣṭhat | tamabravīt | tvaṃ vai pūrvam̐ samabhūḥ | tvamidaṃ pūrvaḥ kuruṣveti, iti | sa ita ādāyāpaḥ | añjalinā purastādupādadhāt |

original: evā hyeveti | tata āditya udatiṣṭhat | sā prācī dik, iti | athā''ruṇaḥ keturdakṣiṇata upādadhāt | evā hyagna iti | tato vā agnirudatiṣṭhat | sā dakṣiṇā dik | athā''ruṇaḥ ketuḥ paścādupādadhāt | evā hi vāyo iti | tato vāyurudatiṣṭhat | sā pratīcī dik | athā''ruṇaḥ keturuttarata upādadhāt | evā hīndreti | tato vā indra udatiṣṭhat | sodīcī dik |

original: athā''ruṇaḥ keturmadhya upādadhāt | evā hi pūṣanniti | tato vai pūṣodatiṣṭhat | seyaṃ dik | athā''ruṇaḥ keturupariṣṭādupādadhāt | evā hi devā iti | tato devamanuṣyāḥ pitaraḥ | gandharvāpsaścodatiṣṭhan | sordhvā dik, iti | yā vipruṣo vi parāpatan | tābhyo'surā rakṣāṃsi piśācāścodatiṣṭhan | tasmātte parābhavan | vipruḍbhyo hi te samabhavan, iti |
analyzed: atha aruṇaḥ ketuḥ madhye upādadhāt eva hi pūṣan iti tatas vai pūṣā udatiṣṭhat sā iyam diś atha aruṇaḥ ketuḥ upariṣṭāt upādadhāt eva hi devāḥ iti tatas deva manuṣyāḥ pitaraḥ gandharva apsaścā udatiṣṭhan sā ūrdhvā diś iti yāḥ vipruṣaḥ vi parāpatan tābhyaḥ surāḥ rakṣāṃsi piśācāḥ ca udatiṣṭhan tasmāt te parābhavan vipruḍbhyaḥ hi te samabhavan iti

original: tadeṣā'bhyanūktā , iti | āpo ha yadbṛhatīrgarbhamāyan | dakṣaṃ dadhānā janayantīḥ svayaṃbhum | tata ime'dhyasṛjyanta sargāḥ | adbhyo vā idaṃ samabhūt | tasmādidaṃ sarvaṃ brahma svayaṃbhviti, iti | tasmādidaṃ sarvaṃ śithilamivādhruvamivābhavat, iti | prajāpatirvāva tat | ātmanā''tmānaṃ vidhāya | tadevānuprāviśat, iti | tadeṣā'bhyanūktā iti |

original: vidhāya lokānvidhāya bhūtāni | vidhāya sarvāḥ pradiśo diśaśca | prajāpatiḥ prathamajā ṛtasya | ātmanā''tmānamabhisaṃviveśeti, iti | sarvamevedamāptvā | sarvamavarudhya | tadevānupraviśati | ya evaṃ veda iti ||
analyzed: vidhāya lokān vidhāya bhūtāni vidhāya sarvāḥ pradiśaḥ diśaḥ ca prajāpatiḥ prathama jāḥ ṛtasya ātmanā ātmānam abhisaṃviveśa iti iti sarvam eva idam āptvā sarvam avarudhya tat eva anupraviśati yaḥ evam veda iti

original: iti kṛṣṇayajurvedīya taittirīyāraṇyake prathamaprapāṭhake trayoviṃśo'nuvākaḥ | | 1.23 ||
analyzed: iti kṛṣṇayajurvedīya taittirīyāraṇyake prathama prapāṭhake trayoviṃśaḥ nuvākaḥ 123

original: catuṣṭayya āpo gṛhṇāti | catvāri vā apāṃ rūpāṇi | megho vidyut | stanayitnurvṛṣṭiḥ | tānyevāvarundhe, iti | ātapati varṣyāṃ gṛhṇāti | tāḥ purastādupadadhāti | etā vai brahmavarcasyā āpaḥ | mukhata eva brahmavarcasamavarundhe | tasmānmukhato brahmavarcasitaraḥ , iti | kūpyā gṛhṇāti | tā dakṣiṇata upadadhāti | etā vai tejasvanīrāpaḥ |
analyzed: catuṣṭayyaḥ āpaḥ gṛhṇāti catvāri vai apām rūpāṇi meghaḥ vidyut stanayitnuḥ vṛṣṭiḥ tāni eva avarundhe iti ātapati varṣyām gṛhṇāti tāḥ purastāt upadadhāti etāḥ vai brahmavarcasyāḥ āpaḥ mukhataḥ eva brahmavarcasam avarundhe tasmāt mukhataḥ brahmavarcasitaraḥ iti kūpyāḥ gṛhṇāti tāḥ dakṣiṇatas upadadhāti etāḥ vai tejasvanīḥ āpaḥ

original: teja evāsya dakṣiṇato dadhāti | tasmāddakṣiṇo'rdhastejasvitaraḥ,iti | sthāvarā gṛhṇāti | tāḥ paścādupadadhāti | pratiṣṭhitā vai sthāvarāḥ | paścādeva pratitiṣṭhati, iti | vahantīrgṛhṇāti | tā uttarata upadadhāti | ojasā vā etā vahantīrivodgatīriva ākūjatīriva dhāvantīḥ | oja evāsyottarato dadhāti | tasmāduttaro'rdha ojasvitaraḥ, iti |
analyzed: tejaḥ eva asya dakṣiṇatas dadhāti tasmāt dakṣiṇa ūrdhaḥ tejasvitaraḥ iti sthāvarāḥ gṛhṇāti tāḥ paścāt upadadhāti pratiṣṭhitāḥ vai sthāvarāḥ paścāt eva pratitiṣṭhati iti vahantīḥ gṛhṇāti tāḥ uttaratas upadadhāti ojasā vai etāḥ vahantīḥ iva udgatīḥ iva ākūjatīḥ iva dhāvantīḥ ojaḥ eva asya uttaratas dadhāti tasmāt uttara ūrdhaḥ ojasvitaraḥ iti

original: saṃbhāryā gṛhṇāti | tā madhya upadadhāti | iyaṃ vai saṃbhāryāḥ | asyāmeva pratitiṣṭhati, iti |

original: suvarṇaṃ gharmaṃ pariveda venam | indrasyā''tmānaṃ daśadhā carantam | antaḥ samudre manasā carantam | brahmā'nvavindaddaśahotāramarṇe | antaḥ praviṣṭaḥ śāstā janānām | ekaḥ sanbahudhā vicāraḥ | śataṃ śukrāṇi yatraikaṃ bhavanti | sarve vedā yatraikaṃ bhavanti | sarve hotāro yatraikaṃ bhavanti | sa mānasīna ātmā janānām |

original: abadhnanpuruṣaṃ paśum, iti | taṃ yajñaṃ barhiṣi praukṣan | puruṣaṃ jātamagrataḥ | tena devā ayajanta | sādhyā ṛṣayaśca ye, iti | tasmādyajñātsarvahutaḥ | saṃbhṛtaṃ pṛṣadājyam | paśūṃstāṃścakre vāyavyān | āraṇyāngrāmyāśca ye, iti | tasmādyajñātsarvahutaḥ | ṛcaḥ sāmāni jajñire | chandāṃsi jajñire tasmāt | yajustasmādajāyata , iti |
analyzed: abadhnan puruṣam paśum iti tam yajñam barhiṣi praukṣan puruṣam jātam agratas tena devāḥ ayajanta sādhyāḥ ṛṣayaḥ ca ye iti tasmāt yajñāt sarva hutaḥ saṃbhṛtam pṛṣadājyam paśūn tān cakre vāyavyān āraṇyān grāmyāḥ ca ye iti tasmāt yajñāt sarva hutaḥ ṛcaḥ sāmāni jajñire chandāṃsi jajñire tasmāt yajuḥ tasmāt ajāyata iti

original: tasmādaśvā ajāyanta | ye ke cobhayādataḥ | gāvo ha jajñire tasmāt | tasmājjātā ajāvayaḥ, iti | yatpuruṣaṃ vyadadhuḥ | katidhā vyakalpayan | mukhaṃ kimasya kau bāhū | kāvūrū pādāvucyete, iti | brāhmaṇo'sya mukhamāsīt | bāhū rājanyaḥ kṛtaḥ | ūrū tadasya yadvaiśyaḥ | padbhyām śūdro ajāyata, iti | candramā manaso jātaḥ | cakṣoḥ sūryo ajāyata |
analyzed: tasmāt aśvāḥ ajāyanta ye ke ca ubhayāt atas gāvaḥ ha jajñire tasmāt tasmāt jātāḥ aja avayaḥ iti yat puruṣam vyadadhuḥ katidhā vyakalpayat mukham kim asya kau bāhū kau ūrū pādau ucyete iti brāhmaṇaḥ usya mukham āsīt bāhuḥ rājanyaḥ kṛtaḥ ūrū tat asya yat vaiśyaḥ padbhyām śūdraḥ ajāyata iti candramāḥ manasaḥ jātaḥ cakṣoḥ sūryaḥ ajāyata

original: mukhādindraścāgniśca | prāṇādvāyurajāyata, iti | nābhyā āsīdantarikṣam | śīrṣṇo dyauḥ samavartata | padbhyāṃ bhūmirdiśaḥ śrotrāt | tathā lokāṃ akalpayan , iti | vedāhametaṃ puruṣaṃ mahāntam | ādityavarṇaṃ tamasastu pāre | sarvāṇi rūpāṇi vicitya dhīraḥ | nāmāni kṛtvā'bhivadanyadāste, iti | dhātā purastādyamudājahāra |
analyzed: mukhāt indraḥ ca agniḥ ca prāṇāt vāyuḥ ajāyata iti nābhyāḥ āsīt antarikṣam śīrṣṇaḥ dyauḥ samavartata padbhyām bhūmiḥ diśaḥ śrotrāt tathā lokān akalpayan iti veda aham etam puruṣam mahāntam āditya varṇam tamasaḥ tu pāre sarvāṇi rūpāṇi vicitya dhīraḥ nāmāni kṛtvā abhivadan yat āste iti dhātā purastāt yam udājahāra

original: śakraḥ pravidvānpradiśaścatasraḥ | tamevaṃ vidvānamṛtaṃ iha bhavati | nānyaḥ panthā ayanāya vidyate, iti | yajñena yajñamayajanta devāḥ | tāni dharmāṇi prathamānyāsan | te ha nākaṃ mahimānaḥ sacante | yatra pūrve sādhyāḥ santi devāḥ , iti | pūruṣaḥ puro'grato'jāyata kṛto'kalpayannāsandve ca ||
analyzed: śakraḥ pravidvān pradiśaḥ catasraḥ tam evam vidvān amṛtam iha bhavati na anyaḥ panthāḥ ayanāya vidyate iti yajñena yajñam ayajanta devāḥ tāni dharmāṇi prathamāni āsan te ha nākam mahimānaḥ sacante yatra pūrve sādhyāḥ santi devāḥ iti pūruṣaḥ purā ugratas jāyata kṛtaḥ ukalpayan āsan dve ca

original: atandro devaḥ sadameva prārthaḥ, iti | yastadveda yata ābabhūva | saṃdhāṃ ca yāṃ saṃdadhe brahmaṇaiṣaḥ | ramate tasminnuta jīrṇe śayāne | nainaṃ jahātyahassu pūrvyeṣu, iti | tvāmāpo anu sarvāścaranti jānatīḥ | vatsaṃ payasā punānāḥ | tvamagniṃ havyavāhaṃ samintse tvaṃ bhartā mātariśvā prajānām , iti | tvaṃ yajñastvamu vevāsi somaḥ |
analyzed: atandraḥ devaḥ sadam eva prārthaḥ iti yaḥ tat veda yatas ābabhūva saṃdhām ca yām saṃdadhe brahmaṇā eṣaḥ ramate tasmin uta jīrṇe śayāne na enam jahāti ahassu pūrvyeṣu iti tvām āpaḥ anu sarvāḥ caranti jānatīḥ vatsam payasā punānāḥ tvam agnim havyavāham samintse tvam bhartā mātariśvā prajānām iti tvam yajñaḥ tvam u veva asi somaḥ

original: tava devā havamāyanti sarve | tvameko'si bahūnanupraviṣṭaḥ | namaste astu suhavo ma edhi, iti | namo vāmastu śṛṇutaṃ havaṃ me | prāṇāpānāvajiraṃ saṃcarantau | hvayāmi vāṃ brahmaṇā tūrtametam | yo māṃ dveṣṭi taṃ jahitaṃ yuvānā, iti prāṇāpānau saṃvidānau jahitam | amupyāsunā mā saṃgasāthām | taṃ me devā brahmaṇā saṃvidānau |

original: vadhāya dattaṃ tamahaṃ hanāmi, iti | asajjajāna sata ābabhūva | yaṃ yaṃ jajāna sa u gopo asya | yadā bhāraṃ tandrayate sa bhartum | parāsya bhāraṃ punarastameti, iti | tadvai tvaṃ prāṇo abhavaḥ | mahānbhogaḥ prajāpateḥ | bhujaḥ kariṣyamāṇaḥ | yaddevānprāṇayo nava, iti || ekaṃ prajānāṃ gasāthāṃ nava ||

analyzed: udīrṣva nāri abhi jīva lokam ita asum etam upaśeṣe ehi hastagrābhasya didhiṣoḥ tvam etat patyuḥ jani tvam abhisaṃbabhūva suvarṇam hastāt ādadānā mṛtasya śriyai brahmaṇe tejase balāya atra eva tvam iha vayam su śevāḥ viśvāḥ spṛdhaḥ abhimātīḥ jayema

analyzed: agneḥ varma pari gobhiḥ vyayasva saṃprorṇuṣva medasā pīvasā ca nettvā dhṛṣṇuḥ harasā jarhṛṣāṇaḥ dadhat vidhakṣyan paryaṅkhayātai mā enam agne vidahaḥ mā abhiśocaḥ mā asya tvacam cikṣipaḥ mā śarīram yadā śṛtam karavaḥ jātavedaḥ utha id enam prahiṇutāt pitṛbhyaḥ śṛtam yadā akarasi jātavedaḥ utha id enam paridattāt pitṛbhyaḥ

original: nāke suparṇamupa yatpatantaṃ hṛdā venanto abhyacakṣata tvā | hiraṇyapakṣaṃ varuṇasya dūtaṃ yamasya yonau śakunaṃ bhuraṇyum, iti | atidrava sārameyau śvānau caturakṣau śabalau sādhunā pathā | athā pitṝntsuvidatrāṃ apīhi yamena ye sadhamādaṃ madanti, iti | yau te śvānau yama rakṣitārau caturakṣau pathirakṣī nṛcakṣasā |
analyzed: nāke suparṇam upa yat patantam hṛdā venantaḥ abhyacakṣata tvā hiraṇya pakṣam varuṇasya dūtam yamasya yonau śakunam bhuraṇyum iti atidrava sārameyau śvānau catur akṣau śabalau sādhunā pathā athā pitṝn suvidatrām apīhi yamena ye sadhamādam madanti iti yau te śvānau yama rakṣitārau catur akṣau pathirakṣī nṛ cakṣasā

original: tābhyāṃ rājanparidehyenaṃ svasti cāsmā anamīvaṃ ca dhehi , iti | uruṇasāvasutṛpāvuluṃbalau yamasya dūtī carato'vaśāṃ anu | tāvasmabhyaṃ dṛśaye sūryāya punardattāvasumadyeha bhadram, iti |

original: soma ekebhyaḥ pavate ghṛtameka upāsate | yebhyo madhu pradhāvati tāṃścidevāpi gacchatāt, iti | ye yudhyante pradhaneṣu śūrāso ye tanutyajaḥ | ye vā sahasradakṣiṇāstāṃścidevāpi gacchatāt, iti | tapasā ye anādhṛṣyāstapasā ye suvargatāḥ | tapo ye cakrire mahattāṃścidevāpi gacchatāt, iti | aśmanvatī revatīḥ saṃrabhadhvamuttiṣṭhata prataratā sakhāyaḥ |
analyzed: somaḥ ekebhyaḥ pavate ghṛtam eke upāsate yebhyaḥ madhu pradhāvati tān cit eva api gacchatāt iti ye yudhyante pradhaneṣu śūrāsaḥ ye tanutyajaḥ ye vā sahasra dakṣiṇāḥ tān cit eva api gacchatāt iti tapasā ye anādhṛṣyāḥ tapasā ye suvar gatāḥ tapaḥ ye cakrire mahat tān cit eva api gacchatāt iti aśmanvatīḥ revatīḥ saṃrabhadhvam uttiṣṭhata pratarata sakhāyaḥ

original: atrā jahāma ye asannaśevāḥ śivānvayamabhi vājānuttarema , iti | yadvai devasya savituḥ pavitraṃ sahasradhāraṃ vitatamantarikṣe | yenāpunādindramanārtamārtyai tenāhaṃ māṃ sarvatanuṃ punāmi | yā rāṣṭrātpannādapayanti śākhā abhimṛtā nṛpatimicchamānāḥ | dhātustāḥ sarvāḥ pavanena pūtāḥ prajayā'smānrayyā varcasā saṃsṛjātha |

original: udvayaṃ tamasasparipaśyanto jyotiruttaram | devaṃ devatrā sūryamaganma jyotiruttamam, iti | dhātā punātu savitā punātu | agnestejasā sūryasya varcasā || dhehyuttaremāṣṭau ca ||
analyzed: ud vayam jyotiḥ uttaram devam devatrā sūryam aganma jyotiḥ uttamam iti dhātā punātu savitā punātu agneḥ tejasā sūryasya varcasā dhehi uttarema aṣṭau ca

original: yaṃ te agnimamanthāma vṛṣabhāyeva paktave | imaṃ taṃ śamayāmasi kṣīreṇa codakena ca, iti | yaṃ tvamagne samadahastvamu nirvāpayā punaḥ | kyāmbūratra jāyatāṃ pākadūrvāvyalkaśā, iti | śītike śītikāvati hrāduke hrādukāvati | maṇḍūkyāsu saṃgamayemaṃ svagniṃ śamaya, iti | śaṃ te dhanvanyā āpaḥ śamu te santvanūkyāḥ |
